F1 continuous-carry: qualifying scores carry into the final total; Gold outranks Silver on points

ILCA 7 2022 — World Championship, Vallarta MEX · F1 · SI (reference-docs:events/ilca7-worlds-2022/SI.pdf) · results (reference-docs:events/ilca7-worlds-2022/results-sailwave.html)

2 qualifying fleets · → Gold/Silver · discards: 1 discard from race 4.
The Addendum-C classic: one continuous low-point line across qualifying and
final. Real Vallarta was 2 flights (Gold 63 / Silver 63), 6 Q + 6 F races,
DNC base = largest flight + 1 = 64, "max one final-series discard" (SI 18.3.3),
champion J-B Bernaz (FRA) 51 net. Reduced here to 2 flights of 3 over
Q1–Q2 + F1–F2 so a scorer can verify every cell; the real parameters
(continuous carry, per-fleet finals base, max-1-final discard) are preserved.

Two teaching points survive the reduction:
- Qualifying scores stay in the total (b1's two Q wins are half his line).
- Gold outranks Silver regardless of points: y2 (Gold, net 6) is ranked
  ABOVE b2 (Silver, net 5).

Worked line (4 races, 1 discard at 4; the discarded score in parens):
  Gold   b1  1  1 (2) 1  -> total 5, net 3
  Gold   y1  1 (2) 1  2  -> total 6, net 4
  Gold   y2  2  1 (3) 3  -> total 9, net 6
  Silver b2 (2) 2  1  2  -> total 7, net 5
  Silver y3 (3) 3  2  1  -> total 9, net 6
  Silver b3 (3) 3  3  3  -> total 12, net 9
